responsibility: This header defines the `cortexx925_tunings` model for Arm Cortex-X925 in the AArch64 backend. It contributes Cortex-X925-specific register-move costs, detailed AdvSIMD and SVE vector cost tables, scalar/vector issue-resource descriptions, SVE width, memory-move costs, fusion mask, and tune flags such as matched vector throughput and predicate-RMW avoidance, making it the dedicated high-end Armv9 tuning profile used by costing, vectorization, and scheduling logic for this core.
